sources.title: Fabrinet (NYSE:FN) Shares Up 4.7% - What's Next?

stories.summary: Fabrinet closed at $343.21 on Tuesday, up 5.53%, and MarketBeat reported it traded about 4.7% higher at midday on Wednesday on light volume, without naming a catalyst. The shares remain far below their 52-week high after a run of target cuts; MarketBeat's average target is $631.88. Fabrinet reports its quarter on 2 November.

stories.headline: Meta slips 1.2% to $612.49, then edges up about 1% after hours

sources.title: Meta Platforms (META) stock price
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) Stock Falls 1.2% - Here's What Happened

stories.summary: Meta closed down 1.24% at $612.49 on Wednesday, StockAnalysis data show. It recovered to $618.52 in after-hours trading. No new company announcement was reported.

explainer.meaning: Trading after the 4pm New York close; prices can swing a lot on thin volume and the official move is only set the next day.

stories.headline: Fortinet's slide deepens to 26% after hours and drags Palo Alto, CrowdStrike and Zscaler down 6-7%

impacts.why: Large cyber names Palo Alto, CrowdStrike and Zscaler fell 6-7% alongside Fortinet (source 1).

sources.title: Fortinet plunges 26% after-hours and takes Tenable with it as Gen Digital rises

stories.summary: SiliconANGLE reports Fortinet beat forecasts (adjusted EPS $0.91 vs $0.86) and raised full-year revenue guidance, yet fell about 26% after hours. Tenable dropped more than 5% after its own beat, while Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike and Zscaler each fell 6-7%. Gen Digital rose almost 6% on its results.

explainer.meaning: Contracts that trade overnight and hint at where stock indexes may open.

stories.headline: Wall Street edged up after the Fed; Asia mixed this morning as Samsung and Korean chips fall

impacts.why: US shares, about 60% of the fund, edged higher on Wednesday (source 1); Asian markets were mixed on Thursday (source 2).

sources.title: Closing Look — Wednesday, October 28, 2026
Asian shares and U.S. futures are mixed after Google parent Alphabet's earnings disappoint

stories.summary: On Wednesday the S&P 500 rose 0.28%, the Nasdaq 0.27% and the Dow 0.19%, Capp Notes reports. In Asia on Thursday, Korea's Kospi fell 2.2% and Taiwan's Taiex 1.9%, with Samsung down 5.4% despite strong results, while Japan's Nikkei rose 0.2%, AP reports. US futures were mixed after Alphabet's results.

explainer.meaning: The interest rate the US government pays to borrow; when it rises, assets that pay no interest, like gold, can look less appealing.

stories.headline: Gold eases 0.5% to about $4,052 as Treasury yields climb above 5%

sources.title: Closing Look — Wednesday, October 28, 2026

stories.summary: December gold futures settled 0.53% lower at $4,051.60 an ounce on Wednesday, Capp Notes reports. The 10-year US Treasury yield rose 5.2 basis points to 5.04% the same day. Higher yields make non-interest-paying gold relatively less attractive.

explainer.meaning: The Fed's preferred measure of how fast US consumer prices are rising; 'core' leaves out food and energy.

stories.headline: Today 12:30 UK: US growth and inflation figures, expected to show 3.2% GDP growth and core PCE at 3.1%

impacts.why: AP says analysts think a December Fed hike is likely (source 2); today's data feed into that decision.

sources.title: Week ahead: Fed and ECB decisions, US GDP and PCE data
Asian shares and U.S. futures are mixed after Google parent Alphabet's earnings disappoint

stories.summary: AskTraders lists consensus for US Q3 GDP at 3.2% annualised (2.2% in Q2), headline September PCE inflation at 3.6% and core PCE at 3.1% year on year. Both are released at 12:30 UK time. The Fed held rates yesterday with two officials favouring a hike, and AP says analysts see a December hike as likely.

explainer.meaning: The interest the ECB pays banks on overnight deposits; it is the main lever for euro-area borrowing costs.

stories.headline: ECB decides at 13:15 UK: a hold at 2.50% expected, with about 20bps of hikes priced by year-end

sources.title: PREVIEW: ECB Policy Announcement due Thursday, 29th October 2026

stories.summary: Newsquawk expects the European Central Bank to keep its deposit rate at 2.50%, though a hike cannot be fully ruled out. Markets price only 1-2bps of tightening today but about 20bps by the end of 2026. France's budget strains and energy-driven inflation are likely press-conference themes.

explainer.meaning: The main global oil price benchmark, priced in dollars per barrel.

stories.headline: Oil eases in Asia but stays above $100; 10-year Treasury yield briefly tops 5.04%

sources.title: Asian shares and U.S. futures are mixed after Google parent Alphabet's earnings disappoint
Closing Look — Wednesday, October 28, 2026

stories.summary: AP reports Brent crude fell 1.2% to $110.32 a barrel on Thursday and US crude 1.3% to $101.46, after US officials warned renewed military action against Iran could follow the 3 November midterms. The 10-year Treasury yield eased below 5.00% after briefly jumping to about 5.04% on Wednesday. Brent was around $72 before the Iran war began in late February.

topline: Alphabet fell more than 10% after hours to $289.95 on an EPS miss and weaker search growth, despite Cloud doubling; RBC cut its target to $400. Today's session sets the real move for your Mag7 pie.
Amazon reports tonight after the US close: EPS ~$1.96, revenue ~$202bn, AWS ~$45.6bn expected; the 2026 capex plan (~$220bn) matters for Nvidia and Fabrinet.
Cyber shares hit after hours: Fortinet -26%, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike and Zscaler -6-7%, worth watching for ISPY today.
Vistra fell 2.7% after a Scotiabank target cut; Nvidia slipped 1.2% on a DOJ inquiry into its Hugging Face deal.
Nasdaq is 3.8% below its 6 Oct high (28 Oct close); VWRP 2.5% below its high (27 Oct close). US GDP/PCE at 12:30 UK and the ECB at 13:15 today.
